parsers.hybrid_csv: Python csv.reader checks the frozen 10-column header and each authorized row width; pandas.read_csv(usecols=RAW_COLUMNS) parses only the header plus the authorized row chunk.
parsers.binance_flow_csv: Binary line-boundary scan locates the exact authorized archive row without decoding or CSV-parsing excluded data records; optional header signature is checked, prefix bytes/lines are audited separately, and csv.reader parses only authorized rows. Monthly and daily offsets start at their archive period boundary; each monthly source is opened once per range; official daily ZIP uses its binary member stream; verify pinned archive/file SHA-256 and exact minute open/close times.
parsers.pmxt_parquet: PyArrow ParquetFile.iter_batches(columns=EVENT_COLUMNS, batch_size=65536); timestamp[ms, UTC] is normalized to ns before exact cutoff comparisons.

purpose: Materialize historical raw-source inputs, frozen E0041 features, and available native T-60/T-59 book snapshots for later separately authorized review.

scope.feature_key_rule: Opened = market_start_utc - 2 minutes; decision_at_utc = market_start_utc - 60 seconds; feature availability timestamp is represented as Opened + 1 minute only as the frozen contract key, not as proof of historical receive time.
scope.first_row_rule: Resume strictly after the E0047 state through Opened=2026-06-30T23:57:00Z; process 2026-06-30T23:58:00Z once.
scope.last_row_rule: Stop after processing Opened=2026-10-06T23:53:00Z. Do not parse the next minute payload.

feature_representation.flow_join: Use the E0041 historical exact-Opened join, then one float32 cast; unmatched source keys remain float32 NaN.

verified_hybrid_raw_input.provenance: Raw hybrid rows: COIN-M BTCUSD index OHLC, USD-M BTCUSDT trade Volume and auxiliary USD-M OHLC. The pinned extension manifest records official DAPI/FAPI tail payload hashes.
verified_hybrid_raw_input.read_rule: Use checkpoint row cursor and stop immediately after Opened=2026-10-06T23:53:00Z. Do not parse later rows or consult feature caches as value references.

binance_coin_m_index_price.used_as: E0041 index OHLC; never substitute spot, mark, premium, or futures prices.

binance_usd_m_btcusdt.used_as: UM_BTCUSDT OHLC and Volume, plus the six frozen FLOW inputs. Join only on exact UTC open_time.

gamma_market_metadata.purpose: Exact technical market identity and token mapping for calendar slots.

pmxt_market_metadata.purpose: Exact technical lookup for unmatched calendar starts and token mapping; exact start equality only.

pmxt_native_event_parts.partition_rule: Read only existing UTC-hour files intersecting the frozen 25/26-hour initialization windows and T-60/T-59 cutoffs for identified BTC tokens.
pmxt_native_event_parts.event_order: Preserve original Parquet row order as the stable tie key; retain both receive and source timestamps; do not invent sub-millisecond ordering.
pmxt_native_event_parts.missing_interval_policy: Preserve missing source hours and dependent windows; do not acquire a new venue source or synthesize events.

historical_fee_rule.use: Record the frozen historical fee rule and separately record native archived fee evidence at each cutoff. Unknown stays unknown; current values do not fill gaps.
historical_fee_rule.minimum_order: Keep D0019 active. Current share minimums are not historical USDC. No order sizing or minimum-order simulation is allowed.

forbidden_sources: Any holdout feature cache or previously generated holdout feature table as a value reference.
Spot, mark-price, premium-index, or futures data as a replacement for the frozen COIN-M BTCUSD index source.
Post-cutoff book snapshots, REST order books, candles, or trades as substitutes for missing native event tape.
Any target, label, outcome, resolution, payout, prediction, or historical evaluation output.

flow_source_cursor_policy.header_detection: Inspect only the first-line byte signature needed to distinguish an optional CSV header; do not decode or CSV-parse excluded data rows.
flow_source_cursor_policy.authorized_payload_rule: csv.reader begins at the exact archive row corresponding to the authorized segment start and consumes only authorized FLOW rows.
flow_source_cursor_policy.monthly_archive_opening: At most once per month per read_flow_range call; daily sources are opened once per day.

frozen_rules.feature_generation: Use E0041 final feature order/configuration and E0047 verified continuation state. Rebuild BASE64 from the pinned raw hybrid source, overwrite stateful BASE64 columns with the E0047 continuation states, rebuild FLOW6 from exact-time USD-M raw flow fields, then apply the historical exact-Opened float32 join. No fit, refit, selection, tuning, transform fit, calibration fit, or model invocation.
frozen_rules.fee_mode: At each cutoff call the pinned replay fee-mode rule and record its result independently from the latest native fee_rate_bps evidence; retain maintenance_pause and unknown fee evidence without simulating a fill.
frozen_rules.book_initialization: Use the frozen E0038 25/26-hour source-hour window, full initial snapshot and subsequent native deltas; never complement one side to create the other.
frozen_rules.archive_window: lower = market_start_utc.floor('h') - 25 hours; include every UTC source hour through entry_time_utc.floor('h'), inclusive.
frozen_rules.freshness_window: Require the existing E0038 archive-hour freshness rule: every required recent UTC hour from floor(entry_time_utc - 30 seconds) through floor(entry_time_utc) is present and processed.
frozen_rules.source_quality: Call utils.btc_t0009_source_audit.source_quarantine_reasons/source_quality_mask without changing its symmetric UP/DOWN and T-60/T-59 criteria. Missing or unknown fields fail closed.
frozen_rules.market_matching: Join by exact market_start_utc and condition/token IDs. No nearest-time or positional joins; unresolved slots stay nullable UNKNOWN.
frozen_rules.gap_semantics: No interpolation, fabricated candles, forward fills, book complements, synthetic IDs, or relaxed initialization/freshness windows. Apply only E0047 state gap behavior.
frozen_rules.availability_provenance: Binance candle close_time and nominal timestamps do not prove historical receive time. Record source-ready/receive-time provenance as UNKNOWN unless an archived timestamp proves it.
frozen_rules.coverage: Keep feature readiness, T-60, T-59, fee, market identity, source quality, and quarantine causes independent per calendar slot. Do not derive no_trade from data exclusions.

before_source_payload: Checkpoint parent hash and semantic identity remain unchanged.
First resumed minute, exact 5-minute keys, feature order and dtypes, exact FLOW cast/join, and no model invocation.
Book cutoffs immediately before/at/after T-60 and T-59; initial snapshot, native deltas, delete, same-time ambiguity, source gap, fee unknown, and unmatched slot.
Source projection rejects outcome/target/payout/resolution/prediction columns; source-only join is deterministic and exact-keyed.
on_authorized_source_payload: Check row timestamps, duplicate keys, OHLCV/quote-field validity, expected coverage and official-source checksums.
Run the full authorized range, atomically checkpoint, start a fresh process at a frozen partition boundary, and compare a date-selected repeat panel.

resources.active_processes: Observe and preserve; never terminate or reprioritize user jobs.
resources.network: Only free official Binance raw-source downloads for missing allowlisted partitions; bounded retry and checksum. No PMXT/venue download.

outputs.large_products: Local and Git-ignored; code, protocol, tests, canonical records, and small report are versioned.

implementation.stable_event_tie_key: original Parquet row position within UTC-hour part; no fabricated sequence or sub-millisecond timestamp

source_field_types.feature_columns: Exact 102 unique columns and frozen E0041 order from the pinned final bundle; six FLOW values remain float32 after the historical exact-key join, other source dtypes are preserved, and the guarded evaluator casts its model matrix to float32. Each D member uses its exact 86-column order.

evaluator_required_but_intentionally_unp.resolved_at_utc: timestamp[us, UTC] nullable; do not read or populate.
